primary_objective: Update the existing application without rewriting its core. Introduce the approved separation between operation catalog hierarchy and order calculation hierarchy; support production and installation operations, their variants, resource calculations, financial basis, provenance and no-double-count validation.
mandatory_preflight: Open and inspect the actual workspace path and currently running local app before editing.
Identify the real repository root, framework, routes, persistence layer, API, data schema and current operation model from source code. Do not guess or invent these details.

Confirm that the workspace is the existing product cost calculator at the known path/URL. If the path resolves to a different project, stop and report the mismatch instead of editing another calculator.
Read project instructions (AGENTS.md, README, package scripts, existing migration rules) and preserve established conventions.
Create a safe checkpoint/branch or use the project-approved backup method before schema/data migration.
Produce a concise current-state map: existing hierarchy, operation data flow, price persistence, configuration save flow and UI entry points.

included: Operation catalog hierarchy: catalog -> shop -> post -> work -> variant -> parameters.
Order calculation hierarchy: order -> product/assembly -> scope -> stage -> shop -> post -> operation line -> cost components.
Operation creation/editing for manufacturing and site installation.
Calculation methods for direct rates, productivity, person-hours, crew cycles, machine-hours, CNC operator support, batch setup, unique program preparation, composites and external quotes.
Order-level total, planned cost, profit and margin calculation with one global 40% markup.
Unit synchronization and price source UI behavior.
No-double-count validation for alternatives, composite parents/children, CNC operators and overlapping employee intervals.
Import/mapping of the existing calculation model, including format-saw P43 and installation templates.
Show profitability as incomplete when one or more selected operations have missing planned-cost data.
excluded: Do not create a new calculator or replace the existing app with Excel.
Do not rewrite the existing application architecture or switch technology stack.
Do not bulk-update material or fastener catalogs.
Do not restore the 39 source records previously excluded by the user.
Do not add 40% to individual operations or groups.
Do not activate legacy 20% installation work 49 together with detailed installation.

critical_rules: 40% is applied exactly once after summing all selected order lines. No line-level or group-level 40% markup.
Every operation has a measurable quantity basis, calculation method, financial basis and provenance.
The source catalog is Данные.xlsx; Сметный калькулятор СК-V-3.06.xlsx is auxiliary only.
The source unit replaces the app unit. Unit changes do not change price and do not auto-convert existing quantities.
A numeric zero price or "по запросу" means absent price; numeric zero quantity means known zero volume.
Keep full precision internally; display money to two decimals.
Manual price edits preserve the base price and show the exact agreed note; reset restores the base value/formula/note.
CNC operator accompaniment is a separate line per CNC post; rate 2081 RUB/person-hour and post-specific occupancy factors from CALCULATION_MODEL.json.
Work 112 and 113 are separate unique-program preparation lines and are not included in cutting tariffs.
Work 139 is inactive; work 144 is the bandsaw operation; package cut uses the 0.8 multiplier and package size.
Work 35 is preliminary aggregate installation; detailed child operations replace it for the same segment.
Work 37 is site installation/construction scope, not product manufacturing; remove the 2300 RUB/m2 bundled tariff.
Work 175 is out of scope; individual formwork production is costed by its actual production operations.
Work 49 is a legacy 20% installation alternative and must not be active with detailed installation unless explicitly confirmed.
Do not count the same employee overlapping on multiple CNC posts twice.
Do not count composite parent plus child operations, alternate routes or duplicate physical segments twice.
If a selected line has no planned cost basis, mark profitability incomplete; never treat unknown cost as zero.
Keep source tariff reproduction and planned labor cost formulas separate. Do not mix the 1.1776187 / 1.10 source-tariff factors with the planned cost formula.

ui_requirements.unit_change_warning: Единица измерения изменена на базовую. Требуется проверка стоимости и корректности расчёта

acceptance_tests.name: Global markup
acceptance_tests.test: For line bases 100 and 200 RUB, display line bases 100 and 200; order quote must be 420 RUB. No line may independently receive 40%.

acceptance_tests.name: Operator support P01
acceptance_tests.test: For 10 machine-hours at 15 min/hour, operator time is 2.5 person-hours and operator amount is 5202.50 RUB at 2081 RUB/person-hour.

acceptance_tests.name: Operator support P07/P08
acceptance_tests.test: For 10 machine-hours, P07 flat milling at 30 min/hour gives 5 person-hours; P08 3D mode at 40 min/hour gives 6.666666... person-hours.

acceptance_tests.name: Operator overlap
acceptance_tests.test: If one employee has overlapping intervals on two posts, count the union of intervals once; different employees sum.

acceptance_tests.name: Unique programming
acceptance_tests.test: For 240 m contour on work 112, calculate 2 person-hours and 4162 RUB; for 90 m contour on work 113, calculate 3 person-hours and 6243 RUB. Repeated identical parts do not multiply unique programming volume.

acceptance_tests.name: Band saw package
acceptance_tests.test: With single cut rate 79.64 RUB and 4 profiles per package, one package pass rate is 0.8*79.64*4 = 254.848 RUB; different package sizes are separate batches.

acceptance_tests.name: Work 37 separation
acceptance_tests.test: Deck installation appears under site-installation/construction scope and does not increase product manufacturing subtotal; foundation is construction scope.

acceptance_tests.name: Work 175 exclusion
acceptance_tests.test: Work 175 bundled tariff is not selectable in active product estimate.

acceptance_tests.name: Aggregate versus detailed installation
acceptance_tests.test: Work 35 or 34 or legacy work 49 cannot be summed with detailed installation children for the same segment.

acceptance_tests.name: Unit synchronization
acceptance_tests.test: When source unit changes, update unit, preserve price, show warning until next configuration save and do not auto-convert quantity.

acceptance_tests.name: Manual price override
acceptance_tests.test: Manual price edit changes current price only; base price/formula remain unchanged; reset restores base and source note.

acceptance_tests.name: Missing price
acceptance_tests.test: Source price 0 or "по запросу" displays as absent, not 0 RUB.

acceptance_tests.name: Format saw
acceptance_tests.test: Three thickness bands, up to 12 card rows, physical cut length, stroke/sheet counts, cycle override, setup, operator, helper and optional map creation calculate independently; no double operator charge.

acceptance_tests.name: Provenance colors
acceptance_tests.test: Dialogue-origin values are green, model-assigned values amber, catalog values gray, order inputs editable; model-assigned norms are not shown as confirmed.

acceptance_tests.name: No material catalog changes
acceptance_tests.test: Existing material and fastener catalog records remain unchanged by this update.

acceptance_tests.name: Unknown planned cost
acceptance_tests.test: A selected line with a quote price but missing planned cost must not be treated as zero cost; order profit and margin are shown as incomplete.

stop_conditions: If the known path or URL opens a different application, stop before editing and report the mismatch.
If source data is inaccessible, do not fabricate it; continue only with the bundled reference artifacts and report missing source access.
If the current schema cannot represent the new hierarchy without destructive migration, stop and propose a migration plan before applying it.
If an operation has no reliable unit/productivity/rate, mark it missing or preliminary; do not silently set a zero or invented rate.
required_deliverables: Non-destructive data migration or mapping script.
Updated operation and calculation schema documentation.
Automated tests for the acceptance cases.
A concise change log with changed files and migrations.
A report of unresolved preliminary norms and missing source data.
